title: Claude-Mem
resourceType: Persistent cross-session Agent memory plugin / local worker, search Skill and optional cloud services
purpose: 跨 Claude Code 與其他已支援 Coding Agent Session 保存有來源的 Prompt、工具觀察、決策與摘要；透過 Lifecycle Hooks／原生整合蒐集資料，以摘要壓縮、SQLite／Chroma 混合檢索及分層 context injection，在後續工作找回相關歷史，不必將所有先前對話放入 Prompt。
recommendation: 適合長期開發同一專案、頻繁跨 Session 或切換 Coding Agent 的使用者；可先在非敏感測試 Repo 檢查 Hook 互通、memory 搜尋召回、注入範圍和 token 開銷。若專案涉及公司機密、客戶資料或憑證，應先評估 Prompt／工具輸出擷取範圍、模型 Provider 出站、Telemetry 和可選 Cloud Sync；只使用本機資料庫不等於完全離線。注意與現有 Claude／Codex Hooks、MCP Server、AGENTS.md 等設定的重複與衝突。
notes: 2026-10-30 重新查核官方 GitHub main README、package.json、SECURITY.md、LICENSE、v15.5.0 Release、官方安裝／搜尋／Telemetry／Cloud Sync／Private Tags／Auto-Redaction／T3 Code／My Work／TeamBrain 文件。官方最新確認 Release v15.5.0（2026-10-29 發布），Apache-2.0；package.json 的 Node engine 為 ^20.19.0 或 >=22.12.0，安裝也需評估 Bun、uv／Chroma 及主機相容性。安裝可註冊 Hooks、MCP 與本機 Worker（預設 localhost:37777），有檔案讀寫、背景 Process 與本機 HTTP API 權限；不應當成純文字 Prompt。資料庫及搜尋索引位於 ~/.claude-mem/，MCP mem-search 以 search → timeline → get_observations 分層讀取，必要時才回查原始工具 I/O；官方聲稱可節省約 10 倍 Token，這是示例／設計主張，並非本次實測。v15.5.0 的 My Work 可查看請求進度與交接、已記錄的 Deliverables；『In progress』是儲存狀態，不保證 Agent 當前執行；TeamBrain 為可選的團隊分享服務，使用者需選擇分享範圍。官方列出 Claude Code、Codex、OpenCode、T3 Code（Codex／Claude Code Provider）、OpenClaw、Gemini、Pi 及多種 Harness 整合，但不同整合的 Hook、安裝及權限行為不同，不能視為完全相同。安裝器互動模式預選 CMEM Pro，官方說明 30 天免費試用且試用後有訂閱或依條件回退路徑；另可選 Anthropic Plan、OpenRouter、Gemini、Host Observer 或 OpenAI-Compatible Endpoint，價格和成本依選擇而定。預設 Telemetry 含 PostHog 匿名分析及經遮罩之錯誤追蹤，官方可透過 DO_NOT_TRACK=1 或專用設定停用；錯誤訊息雖會遮罩，仍為自由文字且有不可選擇性撤回之風險。Cloud Sync 啟用後會把完整 User Prompt、Observations、Session Summaries 送至 cmem.ai Sync Hub，需另外確認資料處理政策。<private> 標記可避免內容寫入記憶庫，但不會阻止 Live Conversation 看見原文；自動秘密字串遮罩 CLAUDE_MEM_REDACT_ENABLED 為額外 Opt-in，不能當作預設防護已啟用。官方過去曾在 2025-12-16 修補 Command Injection（Issue #354），不能將歷史修補視為全面 Security Audit。未安裝／執行 Plugin、未登入、未實測跨 Agent 回憶、雲同步、Token 節省或安全保證。

architecture.provenance: Official first-party README, docs and release v15.5.0 reviewed read-only 2026-10-30.
architecture.capture: Claude Code Lifecycle Hooks and native host integrations observe Prompt／Tool events; differing integrations may expose different event scopes.
architecture.memory: Local Bun-managed worker, SQLite sessions／observations／summaries; Chroma semantic index complements full-text search, subject to local configuration.
architecture.recall: Context priming plus MCP mem-search Skill. Search compact index, inspect timeline, batch retrieve selected observation IDs, use raw tool I/O only if needed.
architecture.interfaces: Local My Work viewer and memory/settings; optional TeamBrain and cmem.ai Cloud Sync; provider and network behavior must be chosen explicitly.

securityAndPrivacy.localFiles: ~/.claude-mem/ stores database, index, settings, logs and optional deliverables; default worker binds 127.0.0.1, port 37777; confirm permissions and network exposure.
securityAndPrivacy.providerEgress: Observer inference may send session context to Anthropic, Gemini, OpenRouter, CMEM Pro, or configured OpenAI-compatible endpoint. A localhost inference endpoint is possible but not verified by this review.
securityAndPrivacy.sync: Cloud Sync is separately configured; when enabled uploads prompts, compressed observations and session summaries to cmem.ai; user-selected TeamBrain can share project work.
securityAndPrivacy.telemetry: PostHog usage analytics and error tracking are documented as opt-out. Error text is redacted but not zero-risk; check settings and DO_NOT_TRACK=1.
securityAndPrivacy.privacy: <private> tags filter persistence but do not hide sensitive content from live Agent/Provider; automatic pattern redaction is opt-in and may miss unknown secret formats.
securityAndPrivacy.installation: Installer may register plugins/hooks and install dependencies; external scripts and updates were not executed in this review.
securityAndPrivacy.securityHistory: Upstream SECURITY.md reports fixed command-injection findings from 2025-12-16; no independent current security audit was performed.

supportMatrixNote: Official README lists cross-host support, but exact scope differs. T3 Code installer specifically configures native Claude Code/Codex homes and still requires permission/trust handling; remote agent usage must configure plugin on the executing host.

source.type: Official GitHub README, package, LICENSE, SECURITY.md, mem-search SKILL.md, release notes and first-party docs
source.summary: Updated existing resource with verified capabilities, current security limitations and standalone mem-search skill linkage. No external installation, login, model invocation or data movement.
